item.title: YET ANOTHER MAIN HIGHWAY TO BE CLOSED FOR A YEAR IN CROSSVILLE
item.description: TDOT: The bridge located on Hwy 70 North at the Obed River will be closed beginning Wednesday, November 19th, 2025. The duration of the closure is anticipated until December 2026. Please look for detour signage when traveling in this area.
